fr.recommendations:
• Install reflective address numbers visible from the street at the driveway entrance.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective posts or markers to help responders locate the property quickly at night or in reduced visibility.
• Trim vegetation along the driveway to maintain clear overhead and side clearance for emergency vehicles.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings without obstruction.
• Mark or label any gate latches and hardware so responders can quickly identify how to open them without tools.
• Keep at least one perimeter fence gate unlocked or equipped with a lock box to allow responder entry without forcing access.
• Clear vegetation away from the detached structure to allow responders to approach and work around all sides of it.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear of long-term parked vehicles or stored items that would block responder staging near the main residence.
• Trim dense plantings along walkways so responders can move quickly between areas of the property without navigating around overgrowth.
• Post a visible property diagram or address marker near the driveway entrance showing the location of both structures and any access gates.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree cluster closest to the structure to create more open space between the trees and the building.
• Trim branches on large trees that extend over or directly toward the structure.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or within a few feet of the structure's walls.
• Clear low-hanging branches from large trees along the driveway to keep the travel path open and passable.
• Thin shrubs and small vegetation along the driveway edges to reduce the amount of burnable material along the access route.
• Cut back vegetation along the rear of the property where access is limited to allow movement around the structure.
• Remove any dead or dry plant material within the scattered shrub areas near the structure.
• Keep the open green space between vegetation clusters and the structure free of encroaching shrubs or tree seedlings.
• Separate any shrubs growing beneath large trees near the structure so fire cannot travel from ground level into the tree canopy.
